protocol.name: starry_system_v1

description.summary: system shell interface between starry-compositor and starboard

protocol.description:
The compositor owns outputs, input and application windows. The system shell (starboard) draws the home screen, status bar and other system UI on its own surfaces and drives application scenes through this protocol, in the way SpringBoard hosts application scenes through FrontBoard on iOS.
The global is only advertised to the starboard process started by the compositor itself.

entry.name: lock
entry.summary: above everything; takes all input while mapped

entry.name: switcher
entry.summary: above applications, below scene views: app switcher backdrop

entry.name: role
entry.summary: the surface already has a role

request.name: get_layer_surface

description.summary: give a surface a system layer role

request.description: The surface is shown on the given layer at position (0, 0) of the output, in logical coordinates, once it has a buffer. Areas outside the surface's input region pass touches to whatever lies below.

description.summary: send the foreground application to the background

event.name: output
event.description: Sent on bind and whenever the size or scale changes.

event.name: scene
event.description: Followed by the scene's info and state events.

event.name: switcher

description.summary: the user asked for the app switcher

event.description: Sent when a bottom-edge swipe ends in a hold. The foreground scene, if any, has already been sent to the background and hidden; y is where its top edge was, so the shell can continue the motion from there, or -1 if the swipe started on the home screen.

entry.name: none
entry.summary: show at once, e.g. after the shell animated a view

description.summary: bring the application to the foreground

request.name: get_view

description.summary: host a snapshot of this scene

request.description: The view shows a snapshot of the window taken now, scaled into the geometry the shell sets, above the switcher layer. Views take no input and outlive the scene, so a closing card can finish animating.

description.summary: ask the application to close its window
the window is gone; destroy this object
place and scale the view, in logical coordinates
